headline: Quarterly growth was mixed, with a few firms posting strong top‑line expansion while others saw modest or slowing performance.
summary: Coforge led with over 50% revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. LTM, Tech Mahindra and Mphasis delivered double‑digit growth, supported by AI‑led deals. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% and posted only 1.5% growth, the slowest among the majors. Profit trends were uneven, with HCLTech and Wipro seeing profit jumps, while Infosys and Persistent posted weaker earnings.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys AI revenue up 29% YoY and HCLTech AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Guidance adjustments
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY27 revenue guidance, while Mphasis and Coforge raised theirs.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins varied, with OFSS at 47.8% but many peers around 15‑24%, reflecting cost pressures.
